page.content:
Mr Belby (fl. 1996) was a wizard and the father of Marcus Belby. He did not get along with his brother Damocles, as he did not believe brewing potions a worthwhile pursuit, and, as such, the two men had little contact.

page.overview:
Who is Marcus Belby's father?

Mr Belby (fl. 1996) was a wizard and the father of Marcus Belby. He did not get along with his brother Damocles, as he did not believe brewing potions a worthwhile pursuit, and, as such, the two men had little contact.
